independent_derivation_or_calculation: Body of mass M, radius R, MOI I_cm = beta M R^2 rolls down incline theta. Forces: mg down, N normal, f friction up incline. Newton 2: mg sin theta - f = M a. Torque: f R = I_cm alpha. Rolling without slipping: a = alpha R. Then f = (I_cm / R^2) a. mg sin theta - (I_cm / R^2) a = M a. a (M + I_cm / R^2) = mg sin theta. a = g sin theta / (1 + I_cm / (M R^2)).
findings: First-principles derivation matched claimed theorem exactly.
